title: router-dashboard: make gateway-health ping targets configurable
description: The dashboard's gateway-health panel (modules/router-dashboard/api/server.py, handle_gateway_health) pings the default gateway plus hardcoded 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) and 8.8.8.8 (Google). Every other external target in the flake is an option (router-mwan.trackIp, router-dns-service fallbackNameservers, router-ha wan.healthCheck.targets), and consumers cannot change these without patching Python. Add services.router-dashboard.gatewayHealth.targets (list of { name; host; }, default today's two, gateway always included) passed to the API through its config, document it, and add an eval check that the rendered config carries the targets. Raised by the operator on 2026-11-22.
